fsim — IMGMETRICS perceptual op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fsim(ref, dist, data_range: 'float' = 255.0) -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import iqafsim; iqafsim.fsim(ref, dist, data_range: 'float' = 255.0) -> 'float'; from the registry, opsimgmetrics.get("fsim"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

FSIM(輝度のみ、1 = 同一、higher is better)。TID2013 の FSIM.txt と 4 桁一致するのは Y′ limited の灰色画像を渡したとき

(`iqatid.tid2013_evaluate(root, fsim, luma="limited_u8")、3,000 組 max |差| 5.0e-5)。詳細 :func:fsim_pair`。
